title: Presupposition projection, toy
question: Which small combination of connective tables and a felicity notion accounts for the toy filtering facts with the fewest principles?

suggestions: Add a Weak Kleene disjunction and see which facts T-WK gains.
Add a fact separating Middle Kleene from a symmetric theory.
goals: Compare Strong, Weak and Middle Kleene on the filtering facts.
Show the pending, out of scope and conflict states.
